As a Program Manager (Deputy Division Administrator), you will: Participates with the Division Administrator in developing and implementing Federal-aid oversight initiatives and stewardship functions through an annual risk assessment of the State's Federal-aid program.

Manages process reviews to improve and enhance project and program decision-making. Recommends quality improvements in division office delivery systems for transportation projects.

Provides program expertise to State and local government officials and engineers to ensure effective program delivery in accordance with Title 23 and related applicable Federal laws.

Direct a multi-disciplinary staff, through subordinate supervisors and team leaders, in providing responsible program and project delivery, technical assistance, and training in the administration of the Federal-aid highway program.

Develop and implement standard operating procedures, manuals and guidance documents for staff to ensure consistent and efficient program delivery. Communicates organizational strategies, goals, objectives and priorities to internal and external audiences. Builds cohesive coalitions and partnerships with State and local officials.

Create and utilize assessment tools to develop, coordinate, implement, and track the Division's Annual Performance Plan. The ideal candidate for this position will have broad knowledge of the Federal-aid Highway Program.

Diverse experience in all aspects of transportation project development from planning through construction, and experience leading a team of transportation professionals. The candidate will also have several years of experience with Federal-aid or Federal Lands Highway program management.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications for the grade at which you are requesting consideration.

To qualify for the Grade 14, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-13, it must include: Experience performing program management principles and practices relating to Federal-aid surface transportation programs, such as providing technical assistance and guidance to state DOTs and local agencies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of program and project delivery, determining eligibility and authorizing expenditure of federal-aid funds, and ensuring compliance with applicable Title 23 and 49 regulations.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Administration and Management - Knowledge of planning, coordination, and execution of business functions, resource allocation, and production.

Compliance - Knowledge of procedures for assessing, evaluating, and monitoring programs or projects for compliance with Federal laws, regulations, and guidance.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Developing Others - Develops the ability of others to perform and contribute to the organization by providing ongoing feedback and by providing opportunities to learn through formal and informal methods. Leadership - Influences, motivates, and challenges others; adapts leadership styles to a variety of situations.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

For additional information about applying to Federal positions, please click on the following link: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-policies/#url=e4 All applicants must meet all qualification requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Ihre Karriere im technischen Projektmanagement.
Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING unterstützen Sie anspruchsvolle Projekte im industriellen Umfeld und übernehmen frühzeitig Verantwortung für eigene Teilprojekte. Sie koordinieren Projektabläufe, sorgen für transparente Prozesse und tragen dazu bei, Projekte effizient und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Aufgaben
Projektmanagement: Sie unterstützen die Projektleitung im Tagesgeschäft und übernehmen eigenverantwortlich Teilprojekte.
Projektplanung: Sie erstellen und pflegen Zeitpläne, Meilensteine sowie Maßnahmenlisten und verfolgen den Projektfortschritt.
Projektcontrolling: Sie überwachen Termine, Risiken und offene Aufgaben und unterstützen eine zielgerichtete Projektsteuerung.
Koordination: Sie stimmen sich bereichsübergreifend mit Produktion, Logistik, Supply Chain Management und Qualitätssicherung ab.
Meetings: Sie bereiten Besprechungen vor und nach, erstellen Präsentationen sowie Protokolle und verfolgen vereinbarte Maßnahmen.
Dokumentation: Sie strukturieren Projektunterlagen und pflegen Projektdaten in SharePoint, Planner und weiteren Projektmanagement-Tools.
Prozessentwicklung: Sie unterstützen bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung abteilungsübergreifender Projektmanagement-Methoden und Softwarelösungen.
Qualifikation
Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene technische Weiterbildung oder Studium, z. B. im Maschinenbau, in der Produktionstechnik oder Logistik, ergänzt durch einschlägige Berufserfahrung
Erfahrung: praktische Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder im Produktions- / Logistikumfeld, einschließlich Trouble-Shooting
Projektmanagement: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, sowie Erfahrung mit MS Teams, SharePoint, Planner; Kenntnisse in MS Project sind von Vorteil
Arbeitsweise: Strukturierte, proaktive und eigenverantwortliche Herangehensweise mit ausgeprägtem Organisationsgeschick
Kommunikation: Kommunikationsstärke sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen
Sprachen: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)

Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
Zukunftssichere Projekte: Arbeiten Sie an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten im Produktions- und Logistikumfeld und übernehmen Sie frühzeitig Verantwortung
Dynamisches Team: Kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

Job Title: Project Manager, Large Projects CMD Commercial Job Location: Remote, California, United States of America Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Full time Job Seniority Level: Work Schedule: 40 hours per week Work Schedule First Shift (Days) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Job Description As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale.

Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION: At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll manage complex strategic projects that make a meaningful impact on our mission to enable customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

As Sr Project Manager, you'll guide successful execution of important initiatives across functions, ensuring timely delivery, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment.

You'll manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously, coordinating cross-functional teams through the complete project lifecycle while maintaining focus on business objectives and quality standards.

Your expertise will be instrumental in implementing process improvements, new technologies, and transformational changes that enhance operational efficiency and customer success.

Project Manager – Large Projects Administrative Project Management Focus Position Summary The Project Manager – Large Projects is responsible for the administrative coordination, governance, documentation, tracking, and reporting required to support large, complex projects.

This role ensures that project information is organized, timelines are visible, actions are tracked, risks and issues are documented, and stakeholders have accurate information to support decision-making. This role does not own solution design, deployment strategy, customer adoption, operational readiness, or business execution.

Instead, the Project Manager provides the structure, cadence, documentation, and administrative discipline needed to keep large projects organized and transparent.

This is an individual contributor role that works closely with project sponsors, workstream owners, Solution Deployment Leaders, commercial teams, operations, finance, legal, quality, supply chain, digital, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities: Project Administration and Coordination Maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, action trackers, decision logs, risk logs, issue logs, and dependency trackers. Coordinate project meetings, governance forums, steering committee reviews, and stakeholder update sessions.

Prepare meeting agendas, capture minutes, document decisions, and follow up on assigned actions. Ensure project documentation is complete, current, organized, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders. Support consistent use of project templates, tools, trackers, and reporting formats.

Governance Support Support project governance by maintaining meeting cadence, escalation records, approval documentation, and decision history. Track required approvals, sign-offs, stage gates, and governance checkpoints. Ensure project sponsors and workstream owners have accurate information for reviews and decisions.

Maintain visibility to open decisions, overdue actions, unresolved issues, and upcoming milestones. Help ensure governance processes are followed consistently across large projects. Timeline and Milestone Tracking Maintain the master project timeline based on input from workstream owners and accountable business leads.

Track progress against milestones, deliverables, and agreed due dates. Identify and flag timeline variances, overdue items, and dependency gaps for review by accountable owners. Consolidate updates from multiple workstreams into a single project view. Support visibility to critical path items without owning execution of the underlying work.

Reporting and Communication Support Prepare project status reports, dashboards, executive summaries, and stakeholder updates. Consolidate inputs from workstream owners, deployment leaders, finance, operations, commercial teams, and other functions.

Ensure project reports clearly reflect status, milestones, risks, issues, decisions needed, and next steps. Maintain accurate records of project communications and leadership updates. Support consistent and timely information flow across project stakeholders. Risk, Issue, and Action Tracking Maintain risk, issue, action, and dependency logs.

Document risk descriptions, issue status, owners, target dates, mitigation updates, and escalation history. Follow up with accountable owners to obtain updates and closure status. Flag overdue actions, unresolved issues, or missing information to project sponsors or designated leads.

Support escalation documentation but does not own resolution of technical, operational, commercial, or deployment issues. Budget and Resource Administration Track project budget information, purchase orders, invoices, resource assumptions, and financial updates as directed by finance or project sponsors.

Consolidate budget and resource inputs for project reporting. Maintain documentation related to project spend, approvals, forecasts, and financial decisions. Support administrative coordination of vendor documentation, contracts, statements of work, and related records.

Flag missing financial information, pending approvals, or budget variances for review by accountable owners. Documentation and Records Management Maintain organized project repositories, files, version control, and document naming standards.

Ensure key project documents, approvals, meeting records, reports, and governance materials are stored appropriately. Support audit readiness by maintaining clear records of decisions, approvals, risks, changes, and status updates. Capture lessons learned and archive project materials at project close.

Support continuous improvement of project administration tools, templates, and documentation practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, project management, life sciences, engineering, or related field preferred.

Experience supporting large projects, complex initiatives, project management offices, commercial operations, business operations, or administrative project coordination. Strong skills in project documentation, meeting coordination, status reporting, action tracking, and records management.

Ability to consolidate information from multiple stakeholders into clear, accurate project updates. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple deadlines, documents, trackers, and reporting cycles. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Proficiency with project management, collaboration, reporting, and productivity tools. Ability to work in a matrixed organization and follow up with stakeholders across functions and levels. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting large customer, commercial, operational, supply chain, digital, or transformation projects.

Experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical, biopharma, healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory, manufacturing, or regulated environments. Familiarity with project governance, PMO practices, stage-gate processes, and executive reporting.

Experience with tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Power BI, CRM, ERP, or similar platforms. Understanding of budget tracking, purchase order processes, vendor documentation, or contract administration. Project management certification or training preferred but not required.

Key Competencies Project administration Documentation management Meeting coordination Status reporting Timeline tracking Action-item follow-up Risk and issue logging Governance support Records management Attention to detail Stakeholder follow-up Tool and tracker discipline Scope and Impact The Project Manager – Large Projects is an individual contributor role focused on the administrative management of large, complex projects.

The role supports project transparency, governance discipline, documentation quality, leadership visibility, and timely follow-up. The role does not own solution deployment, customer adoption, operational readiness, business execution, technical solution design, or commercial strategy.

Accountability for those activities remains with designated business owners, Solution Deployment Leaders, Solution Architects, commercial leaders, and functional teams. Travel Requirements Limited travel may be required for project meetings, governance sessions, workshops, or site-based coordination.

Compensation and Benefits The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $112,500.00–$168,500.00. This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy.

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional The PCBH Deputy Program Manager serves as the professional leader of three PCBH teams at three locations and reports to the PCBH Program Manager. PCBH is co-located with the Primary Care medical teams, with an emphasis on integration of mental health services within primary care.

This responsibility requires broad-based clinical, administrative and supervisory knowledge and skills. Incumbent works closely and collaboratively with primary care medical teams within their designated clinic locations. Duties may include but are not limited to: 1.

As a full clinical member of the PCBH Team, incumbent conducts initial and comprehensive psychosocial assessments of Veterans referred by the Primary Care providers. They review all data, subjective and objective, and make a clinical assessment, identifying needs and strengths. Effectively uses professional skill, objectivity and insight.

Uses clinical training, insight and experience to interpret data and to identify viable treatment options. Assesses high risk factors, acuity and need for services.

Based on a comprehensive assessment, the incumbent uses professional judgment and advanced practical skills to make a clinical diagnosis and prognosis Treatment provided will be short term, problem focused and part of the care provided by the Patient Aligned Care Team (PACT). 2.

The PCBH Deputy Program Manager provides insightful assessment of cases involving mental health diagnoses, catastrophic medical conditions, dementia, and other high-risk diagnoses and determines if effective treatment can be provided with a short-term intervention or requires a longer term intervention.

Those cases requiring longer term treatment as determined by the incumbent will initially or later be referred to the BHIP or other specialty programs for such treatment (e.g. ADTP, PTSD, MHICM, etc.). 3.

Incumbent coordinates and provides mental health treatment for Veterans assigned to PACT; actively contributes to their PACT teams regarding goals, objectives and interventions for psychosocial and clinical treatment; and recommends adjustments to the Veterans treatment plans and interventions based on any changing needs and/or responses to interventions. 4.

Provides consultation services for primary care providers to maximize the effectiveness of their interventions in reducing health-risk behaviors and enhancing health-promoting behaviors, with a significant emphasis on a prevention-oriented model of care. 5.

The PCBH Deputy Program Manager may consult with other specialists in planning treatment for Veterans with co-morbidities. 6.Provides short term individual, family and group therapy services in accordance with the needs identified in the assessment and treatment plan. 7.Ultimately responsible for all entries in the Veteran's medical record (CPRS) and timely completion thereof, including discharge summaries and patient encounters. 8.Responsible for completion of all assigned clinical reminders for patients under their care, and performance measures assigned to the Care Line.

Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re-specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re-specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: (a) The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA, or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, (b) the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

NOTE: The applicant must provide an official transcript and/or certificate documenting the completion of the re-specialization program, which includes completion of an APA or CPA internship. [Psychologists who have successfully completed a re-specialization program as described above and who were employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs prior to the implementation of this standard are considered to have fully met the educational requirements of these qualification standards.] [OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature.] AND Internships (a) Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR (b) New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern, OR (c) VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96-151 (pre-1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR (d) Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) [OR (e) Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program.

NOTE: Psychologists who meet the requirements of this revision and who were employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs prior to the implementation of this standard are considered to have fully met the requirements of this qualification standard. Licensure.

Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia. English Language Proficiency. Social workers must be proficient in spoken and written English.

Für unseren Kunden, Sitz in Bern, suchen wir ab sofort einen Projektleiter/-in. Bei der Position handelt es sich um eine direkte Festanstellung bei unserem Kunden. Die Betreuung und Vermittlung sowie alle unsere weiteren Serviceleistungen sind für Sie als Bewerber kostenfrei.
### Ihre Tätigkeit ###
Sie sind verantwortlich für die fachgerechte Projektierung sowie Ausführung von Projekten in der Baubranche. Schwerpunkte Ihres Tätigkeitsgebiets sind unter anderem:
Projektierung und Ausführung der technischen Isolierungsarbeiten im Bereich Haustechnik oder im Brandschutz

Führungsaufgaben (Montagepersonal)

Sie arbeiten in den Branchen Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär oder Spenglerei. Eine gute Ausdrucksweise in Wort und Schrift sowie Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint und CAD) runden Ihr Profil ab.

s.h: A taste of what you’ll do
s.t:
The Technical Project Manager is responsible for leading complex, high-impact projects and programs that span multiple departments, regions, or product lines. This role combines strategic leadership, technical expertise, and operational excellence to deliver projects that drive organizational growth and innovation.
The Technical Project Manager ensures alignment between business strategy and project execution, mentors mid-level PMs, and influences key stakeholders across technical, operational, and executive levels. This role is central to fostering project management excellence, implementing advanced methodologies, and leveraging technology — including AI-enabled tools — to improve delivery and decision-making.
End-to-end project delivery
Own and manage the full lifecycle of complex and cross-functional projects, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget.
Lead strategic initiatives such as market entries, platform enhancements, certifications, and product launches.
Coordinate dependencies and deliverables across multiple departments.
Strategic roadmap alignment
Partner with senior leadership and product teams to translate strategic objectives into structured project plans.
Support roadmap prioritization by assessing feasibility, risks, and business impact.
Ensure that project outcomes align with organizational targets and regulatory requirements.
Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management
Lead and influence cross-department teams — including Product, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Commercial, BI, and Engineering — facilitating effective collaboration and resolving conflicts across multi-team initiatives.
Mentor junior Project Managers and contribute to raising the maturity of the PM function.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior leadership, external partners, vendors, and regulatory contacts, providing clear communication, alignment, and expectation-setting throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage project decisions and escalate critical issues when necessary.
Risk management and governance
Develop and maintain strategic risk frameworks to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks.
Lead risk workshops, implement contingency plans, and ensure compliance with internal governance processes.
Oversee change control procedures to maintain project stability during implementation.
Technical delivery oversight
Demonstrate strong technical understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), integrations, technical architecture, and backend/frontend concepts.
Support technical teams by clarifying requirements, resolving blockers, and ensuring technical milestones are achieved.
Translate technical information into business language for stakeholders and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of project management, task prioritization, and technical support delivery. The right candidate manages support workflows with confidence, translates client requests and goals into clear developer instructions, maintains site security and updates, and thrives on delivering steady enhancement solutions.
At Urban Insight , strong project management means you'll regularly operate across a range of support and maintenance functions. On any given week you may be running QA on small updates, configuring analytics, writing brief requirements, prioritizing tickets, or coordinating with developers.

If you thrive on variety, steady pacing, and helping clients maintain their long-term digital investments, you'll fit right in. If you want a role where your ownership is real and your impact is visible, this is it.

Strong client communication and presentation skills.

Active use of AI tools in your current workflow to improve project delivery efficiency.

Previous success working remotely.

Project Management & Execution Support - Shadow Senior Project Managers on large-scale, complex client engagements to learn agency delivery methodologies and project lifecycles, while actively supporting day-to-day execution, including shepherding development tickets, meeting scheduling and summaries, performing QA testing, and managing content entry.
Process & Delivery Excellence - Manage support schedules, project budgets, and ticket scopes proactively. Participate in internal team and client meetings, evaluate minor technology frameworks or enhancements, and maintain high organization standards for ticket tracking.

To support ongoing digital transformation initiatives and strategic technology projects, they are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager with a strong technical background and the ability to bridge business and technology teams across multiple regions.
## Job Description ##
The IT Project Manager will be responsible for leading end-to-end delivery of complex technology projects in an international environment. This role requires a combination of project management expertise, technical knowledge, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.
The ideal candidate combines strong leadership capabilities with hands-on technical understanding, enabling them to effectively challenge technical teams, manage project risks, and drive successful outcomes aligned with business objectives.
* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of IT projects from initiation through completion.
* Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, and deliverables.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and external partners.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical workstreams and project roadmaps.
* Facilitate communication between infrastructure, software development, cybersecurity, data, and business teams.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
* Ensure adherence to project governance, quality standards, and best practices.
* Coordinate international teams located across multiple countries and time zones.
* Organize steering committees, project status meetings, and executive reporting.
* Monitor project performance through KPIs and project dashboards.
* Support change management and user adoption initiatives.
* Manage third-party vendors and technology implementation partners.
* Contribute to technology strategy discussions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure successful transition from project delivery to operational support teams.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience managing IT projects in complex international environments.
* Previous technical experience in areas such as software development, infrastructure, cloud technologies, systems engineering, or enterprise applications.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of IT project delivery methodologies.
* Experience working within multicultural and globally distributed organizations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and system architecture.
* Experience with Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud).
* Knowledge of enterprise applications, integrations, and data flows.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity principles and IT governance frameworks.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies.
* Proficiency with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or similar platforms.
* Ability to understand technical designs, architecture diagrams, and infrastructure landscapes.
* Knowledge of data platforms, APIs, and modern digital technologies is considered an advantage.
## What's on Offer ##
* Opportunity to join a highly international and multicultural organization.
Exposure to strategic, high-impact technology initiatives.
Collaborative and innovative working environment.

Professional development and career growth opportunities.

### Chef de projet logiciel embarqué (médical) ###
Dans notre centre de développement à Wil SG, nous réalisons des produits pour des moyennes et grandes séries et développons des technologies pour des entreprises de pointe, orientées vers l'avenir, à l'échelle mondiale.
Pour soutenir notre équipe de logiciels embarqués dans le développement de dispositifs médicaux et de diagnostics in vitro ainsi que pour des tâches générales dans le domaine du développement logiciel et firmware, nous recherchons un chef de projet.
### Domaine d'activité ###
En tant que personne orientée vers les objectifs avec une expertise technique approfondie, vous supervisez le développement et la mise en œuvre de firmwares et logiciels dans un environnement réglementé pour des applications médicales ou industrielles. En tant que membre expérimenté de l'équipe, vous êtes responsable de la gestion de projet pour la mise en œuvre et l'intégration des firmwares et logiciels avec la qualité requise et conformément au processus de développement.
Vous travaillez au sein d'une équipe d'ingénieurs logiciels hautement qualifiés, d'électroniciens embarqués et de développeurs firmware. Votre motivation et votre méthode de travail structurée vous permettent de mettre en œuvre des solutions technologiques avec efficacité.

* Recueillir les exigences techniques des demandes clients
* Planifier les projets de développement firmware/logiciel en tenant compte des objectifs techniques, financiers et de délais (gestion de projet hybride, avec périmètre, calendrier et budget définis)
* Négocier avec les clients et présenter les résultats
* Coordonner et communiquer en interne ainsi qu'avec les clients
* Diriger vos projets de manière autonome, gérer et motiver l'équipe de développement en respectant les processus et objectifs requis
* Implémenter de nouvelles technologies et méthodes de mise en œuvre
* Éventuellement esquisser initialement l'architecture logicielle / modularisation comme base pour l'estimation des efforts
* Soutenir l'acquisition de clients et prendre la tête de la préparation des offres
### Exigences ###
* Diplôme d'une haute école technique (FH/ETH) et plusieurs années d'expérience en développement de logiciels embarqués/firmware
* Plusieurs années d'expérience en gestion de projet et collaboration dans des équipes interdisciplinaires
* Expérience significative en ingénierie logicielle et système ainsi qu'en architecture
* Curiosité et recherche constante de nouvelles façons d'améliorer ou d'élargir votre efficacité et vos compétences
* Habitude de travailler dans un environnement dynamique orienté client et d'agir en tant qu'interlocuteur compétent auprès des collaborateurs et clients
* Intérêt pour le développement dans un environnement réglementé (IEC 62304)
* Travail structuré et pragmatique
* Communication assurée en allemand et bonnes connaissances en anglais

* Expertise technique dans le domaine des logiciels et firmwares médicaux (IEC 62304)
* Expérience dans le développement agile avec matériel
* Capacité à prendre en charge des tâches de contenu si nécessaire
